sessions.notes: Toolkit integration complete but simplified from original plan. Initially attempted to use rpg-toolkit/tools/environments GraphBasedGenerator but encountered dependency compatibility issues with selectables module (breaking changes in events/dice API). Pivoted to simple graph-based implementations that can be enhanced with toolkit components later. Layout generator creates linear/branching/hub patterns. Shape generator creates rectangular shapes with variation based on style (structured vs organic). Feature generator places obstacles, terrain patches, and spawn zones based on room type and theme rules. Factory provides convenient generator creation and full dungeon generator assembly.

Hint generation and shuffling both use deterministic seeding for reproducibility. This completes the dungeon generation feature - all layers implemented and tested.
